title: How to Use the Windstep Spell in Runescape Dragonwilds Quick Guide
author: PazarGamingGuides
description:
In this quick guide, I'll show you how to use the Windstep spell in RuneScape Dragonwilds. Windstep is an essential mobility spell that allows you to leap across gaps and reach elevated areas, unlocking new paths and hidden treasures. I'll walk you through unlocking the spell, gathering the required runes, and tips for maximizing its effectiveness in your adventures.
